# HarnessDock v0.1.2

HarnessDock v0.1.2 freezes the current stable Electron desktop client on `main` before the Tauri migration is merged.

## Highlights

- Stable Electron desktop client for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Bundled DeepSeek Harness runtime pinned to `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.1` at commit `cd5ef8148158c3a752a658978873241fdf8e2bbc`.
- Transactional runtime activation with health verification and rollback recovery.
- Hardened runtime lifecycle, file-transfer boundaries, OAuth pending-state expiry, and proxy/network recovery.
- Full and thin desktop package variants with prepared runtime bundles for supported desktop platforms.
- This is the final pre-Tauri stable baseline; the Tauri workspace remains outside this release.

## Release scope

The official v0.1.2 release publishes the current stable Electron desktop artifacts for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Tauri desktop/mobile work is intentionally excluded and will be merged only after this baseline release is complete.
